detail.title: 2MP 25 Starlight Non Compensation Light NETWORK PTZ CAMERA
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD52C225DB-HNY 2MP 25 Starlight Non Compensation Light NETWORK PTZ CAMERA Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • High Preset and Manual Speed Make the PTZ Responsive • Optional Smoked Dome Cover & In-Ceiling Mount for Enhanced Concealment • Deep Learning-Based Human and Vehicle Classification • IK10 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless; Tilt: 0° to +90°, auto flip 180° When the vertical field of view is between 0° and 7°, the image might present different degrees of ghosting.
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Supports tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, capturing snapshots, enhancing face images, and face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing and quality first.
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets.
General.Video Compression: H.264H; H.264B; Smart H.265+; H.264; H.265; MJPEG (Sub Stream); Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080P/1.3M/720P@(1-25/30 fps) Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF@(1-25/30 fps) Sub stream 2: 1080P/1.3M/720P@(1-25/30 fps)
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; tracking; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
General.Audio Compression: PCM; G.711A; G.711MU; G.726; MPEG2-Layer2; G.722.1
General.Network Protocol: FTP; RTMP; IPv6; Bonjour; IPv4; DNS; RTCP; PPPoE; NTP; RTP; 802.1x; HTTPS; SNMP; TCP/IP; DDNS; UPnP; NFS; ICMP; UDP; IGMP; SMB; HTTP; SSL; DHCP; SMTP; Qos; RTSP; ARP
General.Storage: Micro SD card (512 GB); FTP/SFTP; NAS
General.Browser: Web 5.0: IE 9 and later versions Chrome 41 and later versions Firefox 50 and later versions Safari 10 and later versions
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recoding; send email; preset; tour; pattern; alarm digital output
General.Alarm Event: Motion/Tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Power Consumption: 24 VDC: Basic: 13 W Max: 16 W (PTZ) PoE+ (802.3at): Basic: 13 W Max: 15 W (PTZ)
General.Protection: IK10; 6000V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
